name: Meridian Waste Solutions
notes: Moved from the catalog default utility-account family to the trash-specific waste-hauler family. Researched from the public meridianwaste.com home page (My Account menu: Pay My Bill, Select Billing Options, Change Account Password, Request Extra Pick Up, Report Missed Collection, Help / FAQ, all linking to the Soft-Pak Web-Pak sign-in), the Find a Facility page and the public Meridian Waste Online Bill Pay sign-in page and FAQ; never signed in. Sign-in is one page with E-Mail and a case-sensitive password (8-64 characters, set as passwordRule). Register Now needs the Customer Number (account number plus check digit) and the numeric Access Code from the invoice and is confirmed by an e-mailed link. The Access Code is not expressible (registrationFields has no access-code field and the waste-hauler form always asks for the service ZIP), so dossier copy says "account details printed on your invoice" instead of naming the Access Code (audit 2026-10-10: copy contradicted the form). Residential customers can also request an extra pickup, schedule bulk and white-goods collection and report missed collection online (no mock flow). The FAQ does not describe turning AutoPay off, so autopay_cancel is inferred. No convenience fee, late fee, guest payment or payment-plan policy is published: guest pay and payment arrangements are unsupported online (inferred) and no fees are set. 866-440-3983 is the phone listed for Meridian hauling locations on Find a Facility. New residential subscription sign-ups go through customercare.meridianwaste.com (not modelled).

passwordRule.message: Your password must be 8-64 characters long.

registration.note: Register Now with the Customer Number and the account details printed on your statement or invoice, then confirm through the e-mailed link.

guest_pay.note: Meridian Waste online payments are made after signing in to Online Bill Pay. Register with the Customer Number from your invoice, or call 866-440-3983.

autopay_cancel.note: Automatic payments are managed under Billing Options: choose Modify in the Automatic Payments section to change the payment method.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call Meridian Waste at 866-440-3983 about a past-due balance.

cancel_service.note: Service cannot be stopped through Online Bill Pay. Call Meridian Waste at 866-440-3983 or contact your local facility to stop or change service.

help.title: How to register for Online Bill Pay
paragraphs: On the Meridian Waste Online Bill Pay Sign In page, find the Are you a new user? section and choose Register Now. Enter the Customer Number and the account details the form asks for (all printed on your statement or invoice), your e-mail address and a password, then select Register Now.

An e-mail with a confirmation link is sent to the address you entered. Open the link and sign in to finish. Your e-mail address is your username; you can change it later under User Options, Change Username.

help.title: How to enroll in automatic payments
paragraphs: Automatic payments pay each invoice from a saved card or bank account. You agree to the Terms and Conditions when you pick the payment method.
steps: Sign in and select Autopay Enrollment.
Pick a saved payment method, or choose Add New and enter one.
Check I agree to the Terms and Conditions.
Choose Select (or Add Payment) to finish enrolling.

help.title: How to change automatic payments
paragraphs: Select Autopay Enrollment to open Billing Options, then choose Modify in the Automatic Payments section. Add a new payment method or pick another saved one, agree to the Terms and Conditions and choose Select.

help.title: How to change your bill delivery options
paragraphs: After signing in, select Billing Options. The button only appears when your online login is the admin for that account number.

Three On/Off switches control delivery: E-Mail Notifications Only (an e-mail when the bill is ready to view online), E-Mail Notifications With Bill Attached (the bill as a PDF), and Printed Bill (a paper bill by mail). Choose Submit to save. The same window holds the primary billing e-mail address.

help.title: What you can do in Online Bill Pay
paragraphs: Residential customers can pay online, change the account password, request an extra pickup, schedule an on-call bulk and white-goods collection and report a missed collection.

Have your e-mail address and password ready to sign in. The first time, you also need the Customer Number from your Meridian Waste invoice. Passwords are case-sensitive and must be 8 to 64 characters long.

extra.intent: Using Meridian Waste's Online Bill Pay help, find the allowed password length for an Online Bill Pay account. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
